dedupe_keys.name: latvia buildings inspire from the state land service download and view services

description: State Land Service of Latvia (Valsts zemes dienests) publishes the spatial building data of the Cadastre Information System harmonised to the INSPIRE Annex III theme Buildings and to the EU implementing regulation on high-value datasets, offered as an INSPIRE download service (WFS), a view service (WMS) and a bulk-download Atom feed. Coverage: the whole of Latvia; the portal record was last modified on 2025-04-10, and a second portal record from the geoportal operator, marked CC0, points to the same INSPIRE buildings services. Format and access: WFS download, WMS view and Atom bulk-download services, without registration from the Latvian open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; cost: free. Caveats: the portal page lists the three services but no attribute list or building count, and the services were not queried, so height, use and structural fields are unconfirmed; the cadastre text data on buildings sit in a separate weekly dataset. Simulation uses: national building footprints as exposure input for flood, wind and heat hazard models, geometry for urban digital twins, and a harmonised building layer to join with cadastre and energy-performance records. Related catalogue records: Latvia Cadastre Information System open data: buildings, land units and cadastral values (VZD) (data-latvia-vzd-cadastre-information-system-open-data); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
